evals.name: turns a remembered sequence into a dependency graph
evals.prompt: I've got four steps I keep re-running by hand — download, clean, aggregate, plot — and I have to remember the order every time. Make this repeatable.
evals.expected_output: Produces a Makefile expressing the steps as file dependencies, so ordering is derived and re-runs are incremental.
assertions: The response produces a Makefile or equivalent dependency graph.
The response does not simply list the steps in order for the user to run manually.
